replication.target_description: Edlund direct replication final report: pooled Stage Two final sample, correlation between conception risk and binary preference for Obama over Trump, with other candidate/not voting coded as Trump. Final pooled test selected; Stage One is separately reported.

n.sample_role: Final pooled eligible participant sample for Stage Two correlation
n.exclusions: Eligibility screening is mentioned but criteria and exclusion counts are not documented in the final report. Stage One had 226 eligible participants; Stage Two added 319.

notes: Original title and authors verified against supplied reference. Replication OSF node title and final report identify the supplied study and Edlund team; dyn6j is the final-report DOCX, not a node. Original locator p. 3 identifies Study 1 correlation. Replication reports r, retained as printed despite requested phi; no conversion performed. Stage One reports r(226)= -.086, p=.195; final pooled Stage Two selected for replication values. Replication uses Obama versus Trump, a documented adaptation of the original Obama versus McCain question. No further replication locator was supplied. Final report provides no fixed page numbering; section and paragraph cited.
